answer: Copy-detection on output is a cheap sybil filter. Every deliverable an agent ships is embedded and compared against all others from the same epoch; a farm of forty clones tends to emit work sharing one pigment: identical phrasing, identical mistakes. When outputs cluster above a similarity summit, only the earliest earns credit and the rest wander off unpaid. Example: twenty 'independent' translators returning the same idioms split one reward instead of twenty.
